description: Run the Chocolate Processing (CHOC) demo — Plant Builder's joint DES↔DRS bridge. Three systems in series (Bean Processing → Cocoa Powder → Chocolate): DES schedules campaigns and injects equipment failures, a DRS rate solver carries the continuous flow, a bridge couples them. Exercises all 7 controllers + Goal blocks. Returns the plant rollup (schedule occupancy vs busy utilization, total downtime, campaigns), per-product attainment, and per-system campaign timelines with downtime. ANTI-FABRICATION: numbers come from a real Plant Builder engine run; quote verbatim.
